name: Vignesh J
title: AI Engineer, LLM Agents and Backend Systems
summary: AI engineer with 3 years of experience building LLM agents and the production backends they run on. At PickYourTrail, built AI voice agents that automate customer follow ups, lead qualification, and trip assistance; an agent workflow using the **OpenAI API and Model Context Protocol (MCP)** that automates post call summaries and CRM pipeline transitions; and the MCP agent architecture behind Trippie, a pre trip assistant, with a sandboxed test environment for safe rollouts. Backed by **Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and Redis** services supporting 400+ daily active users across CX, Finance, Sales, Product, and Visa teams, with API response times cut by over 40%. Uses AI assisted development for code review, debugging, and documentation.

bullets: Legacy PHP codebase was becoming hard to maintain and slowing delivery — migrated core systems to modern PHP and Laravel, improving maintainability and long-term scalability for platforms used by 400+ daily active users.

Customer follow-ups, lead qualification, and trip assistance were handled manually — built backend workflows powering AI-based voice automation, using LLM agent tooling and orchestration to automate these touchpoints end-to-end.

Manual post-call logging was creating overhead for CX and Sales teams — engineered an AI agent workflow using the OpenAI API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool wiring to automate post-call summarization and CRM pipeline transitions.
Key modules had slow API response times — optimized API performance and database queries, cutting response time by 40%+ across key modules.
No shared backend served CX, Visa, Finance, Sales, and Product consistently — designed and maintained backend services now supporting 400+ daily active internal users across 5 teams.
CX, Visa, Finance, and Sales relied on manual processing for recurring tasks — built workflow automation for these operations, reducing manual processing time.
Repeated queries were creating redundant database load — implemented Redis-based caching, reducing load and improving response times.
Critical business logic had inconsistent test coverage — wrote and maintained automated tests using Pest to reduce regression risk.

Development and debugging cycles were slower without AI tooling — adopted AI tools across the dev lifecycle, including AI-assisted code review, debugging, and documentation, to accelerate delivery and workflow improvements.
API and database queries were inefficient under load — improved API performance and query efficiency, achieving a 30% system performance gain.
Authentication and encryption gaps created security exposure — hardened authentication and implemented encryption, reducing vulnerabilities.
Backend architecture had scalability limits — contributed to architecture improvements to support continued growth.
System capacity was constrained — assisted in cloud integration efforts, increasing system capacity by approximately 50%.
